mapper.sql: l.id, l.type, l.title, l.description, l.category, l.images, l.location, l.lost_time, l.reward, l.contact, l.status, l.publisher_id, l.create_time, l.update_time
l.id, l.type, l.title, l.description, l.category, l.images, l.location, l.lost_time, l.reward, l.status, l.publisher_id, l.create_time, l.update_time, u.username as publisher_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM lostfound l LEFT JOIN user u ON l.publisher_id = u.user_id WHERE l.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE lostfound SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lostfound_claim (lostfound_id, claimer_id, message, status) VALUES (#{lostfoundId}, #{claimerId}, #{message}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT lc.id, lc.lostfound_id, lc.claimer_id, lc.message, lc.status, lc.create_time, COALESCE(u.real_name, u.username) AS claimer_name, u.phone AS claimer_phone FROM lostfound_claim lc LEFT JOIN user u ON lc.claimer_id = u.user_id WHERE lc.lostfound_id = #{lostfoundId} ORDER BY lc.create_time DESC

SELECT lc.id, lc.lostfound_id, lc.claimer_id, lc.message, lc.status, lc.create_time, COALESCE(u.real_name, u.username) AS claimer_name, u.phone AS claimer_phone FROM lostfound_claim lc LEFT JOIN user u ON lc.claimer_id = u.user_id WHERE lc.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE lostfound_claim SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE lostfound_claim SET status = 'REJECTED' WHERE lostfound_id = #{lostfoundId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE lostfound SET remove_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(l.contact), ''), u.phone) FROM lostfound l LEFT JOIN user u ON l.publisher_id = u.user_id WHERE l.id = #{id}
